newsitem.title: USA: IBM CEO to meet with analysts Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: IBM CEO to meet with analysts Wednesday.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp said chairman and chief executive officer Louis Gerstner will hold his annual meeting with Wall Street analysts Wednesday at 1500 EDT/1900 GMT.

Analysts said they expected the meeting to be a discussion of the computer giant's strategy and direction. "It will be more a statement of direction and strategy," said Bill Milton of Brown Brothers Harriman. "I would be surprised if I come out of that meeting changing earnings estimates." Milton said he expects Gerstner to discuss IBM's booming services business, its "powerhouse" PC business, its resurgence in hard disk drives and its focus on the Internet.

"I'm not looking for any significant changes in strategic direction," said Steve Milunovich, a Morgan Stanley analyst. "There will be more talk about the company's plans to grow, more talk about electronic commerce, talk about network computing and the investments that IBM is making there."

IBM's overall revenue growth in the high single digits has been of some concern among investors in recent quarters. On a constant currency basis, IBM's total revenues grew nine percent in the first quarter, amid a decline in mainframes and minicomputers.
"One might suspect he is going to talk about how he is transforming IBM," said Gary Helmig of SoundView Financial.
